subject: Re: [Project Nimbus] Kickoff: ASVI for the probabilistic modeling stack
body:
Nimbus status + one honest risk.

The Inference Gym sweep is 80% done. Headline: ASVI beats mean-field on ELBO on 7 of 9 models we've run, and matches hand-built structured surrogates on the time-series models while requiring zero modeling effort. That's the product story.

The risk is the other two models: on hierarchical models with strong posterior correlations *across* plates, ASVI's prior-structure inheritance isn't enough and it lands closer to mean-field. For internal users with big hierarchical models this could be the common case, not the corner case. Tereza is adding a diagnostic that flags when the fitted surrogate's ELBO gap suggests structure is being missed, so the API can warn rather than silently underfit.

Proposal: position v1 as "automatic and safe, with diagnostics" rather than "always best". Deck to follow Thursday.

Umar
